Class CraftTweakerAssembly

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.compat.crafttweaker.CraftTweakerAssembly
public final class CraftTweakerAssembly extends Object
Typed ZenScript authoring over StructureAssembly; paths and chemistry use the existing Java validator.
